objective: Test a relabeling-invariant endpoint residual-incidence bit suggested by the unique support-release-surviving 5x4 k4 contradiction, with complete stored reconvergence coverage and flat 4x5 control.

candidate.carrier: exact endpoint state, mover-relative residual family
candidate.cap_set: top-row cap cell of every non-full column
candidate.hole_residual: a mover residual equal to the cap set with exactly one cap omitted
candidate.bit: when exactly one such residual exists, 1 iff its omitted cap is incident to another mover residual; otherwise undefined
candidate.rationale: the two opposite-parity robust routes terminate in exact states with one cap-hole residual each, and the omitted cap has opposite incidence to the other surviving mover residual
candidate.covariance: defined only through support/residual incidence and therefore testable under arbitrary column relabeling

controls.label: 5x4-k4-release
controls.expected_for_discovery_only: candidate should at least separate the known robust route endpoints if the derivation was correct

controls.label: 4x5-k4-release
controls.expected_for_discovery_only: same-parity flat reconvergences must not be silently assumed consistent; measure directly

targeted_observations: column-permutation covariance on every audited defined endpoint
open_observation_channel: Preserve any flat-control inconsistency, undefined robust endpoint, or alternative cap-hole pattern as a model-breaking observation.
anti_circularity: candidate definition fixed before running the flat 4x5 control
syndrome is not used to compute the endpoint bit
raw mask numbers are not part of the definition
undefined states remain undefined rather than being assigned a convenient bit
stopping_rule: If the candidate fails on the robust witness or produces flat-control inconsistencies, reject/narrow it. If it fits but has low coverage, retain it only as a local mechanism clue rather than a complete corrected carrier.
